client_decisions.decision: Prepare only work that is safe without a manufacturer dieline.
Do not label or export artwork as print ready until panel geometry, bleed, folds and safe areas are verified.
Use 120 x 70 x 210 mm, reverse-tuck construction and 350 gsm board only as provisional structural inputs.
